about_the_game:
Mr. Billion is an idle life and economic simulator where you rise from a homeless nobody to a powerful tycoon! Start your journey from the streets, make smart choices, upgrade skills, and climb the career ladder. Build your business empire, find love, and live a luxurious billionaire life. Will you become the next Mr. Billion?

🚀 Start Your Journey from Scratch

Begin with nothing but ambition as you help an unemployed individual rise through the ranks. From humble beginnings to unimaginable riches, every decision counts in this exciting life simulator. Choose your path—study, work, and climb the success ladder, all while managing your money and making life-changing choices.📈

💰 Live Like a Billionaire

Say goodbye to the streets and welcome luxury! Start with a modest dorm, upgrade to a chic apartment, and who knows—maybe you’ll own a luxurious villa or a private island. The world’s your oyster in this life simulation, where every achievement unlocks new levels of wealth and style.🛥️

❤️ Find Love & Build a Family

In this idle simulator, wealth isn’t the only thing that matters. Find your perfect match, build a relationship, and start a family. Will you settle down or keep searching for the one? Love is just as important as money in Mr. Billion, and your decisions will shape your life.👩‍❤️‍👨

🍎 Keep Your Health & Happiness in Check

Balance your lifestyle and well-being to achieve true success. Take care of your health, fulfill your character’s desires, and keep your happiness meter high. After all, what good is all that money if you're not living your best life?🏋️‍♂️

Step into the world of Mr. Billion, an idle life simulator where you can live like a true tycoon. Earn cash, climb the corporate ladder, and indulge in the lavish lifestyle of a billionaire. The dream is waiting—are you ready to live it?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7
  • Processor: 2.33GHz or faster x64-compatible processor, or Intel Atom™ 1.6GHz or faster processor for netbook class devices
  • Memory: 512 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX® 9 Compatible Graphics Card
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DX10, DX11, DX12 capable.

  • Sound Card: DX10, DX11, DX12 capable.
